entries.description: the meaning of any Act of Congress
entries.subject: the meaning

spans.text: In determining the meaning of any Act of Congress, unless the context indicates otherwise—

entries.description: singular include and apply to several persons
entries.subject: singular include

spans.text: - words importing the singular include and apply to several persons, parties, or things;
- words importing the masculine gender include the feminine as well;

entries.description: the future as well as the present
entries.subject: the future

spans.text: - words used in the present tense include the future as well as the present;
- the words “person” and “whoever” include corporations, companies, associations, firms, partnerships, societies, and joint stock companies, as well as individuals;
- “officer” includes any person authorized by law to perform the duties of the office;
- “signature” or “subscription” includes a mark when the person making the same intended it as such;
